title: Craftable End Materials
description:
Adds crafting recipes for End Stone and Chorus Flowers, along with making Husks drop sand.
Intended for worlds/servers with the End disabled.
body:
Intended for servers that disable the End, but still want access to materials such as Purpur, Chorus Fruit/Flowers, and End Stone.

This is a datapack, so no mod loader required.

In order to disincentivize sand dupers (which are, as of 1.21) the only renewable source of sand), Husks now have a chance of dropping Sand on death.

Adds crafting recipes that allow you to get Chorus Flowers and End Stone without having to enter the End. Using vanilla crafting recipes, this means that you can also get Purpur, End Stone Bricks, and End Rods.

This datapack does not add a way to get Shulker Boxes, Dragon Heads, or Elytras, without entering the End.
